content.text:
I fixed this in `src/rules.ts` by changing the inline hard-break rule (`br`). I haven't run it or any tests, since there are no `node_modules`. The rule matched only the trailing spaces (or a backslash) and the newline. The indentation of the next line stayed in the text and came out after the `
`. I changed the rule to `/^( {2,}|\\)\n[ \t]*(?!\s*$)/`, so it also consumes the spaces and tabs at the start of the following line. That covers the two-space break, the backslash break and tabs. The existing check that a break at the end of a paragraph doesn't produce a `
` still works. A final line that is only whitespace still fails to match, as before. The line-breaks-only variant (`breaks: true`) builds on the same pattern, so it gets the same fix. I didn't check the existing specs for cases that expect the whitespace to be kept.
